title: Compliance sprint-wave sync and consequence matrix
creator: Priya Rao
description: Goal: Define and operationalize a sprint-wave based milestone plan for SOC2/ISO controls, SSO/SAML cutovers, and tenant-scoped audit-log retention. Deliver a consequence matrix that maps missed checkpoints to remediation plans and automated gating logic for the Console and Private onboarding flows. This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, Security, and Design owners and produces a single timeline and checklist for pre-audit readiness.
deliverables: Staggered sprint-wave schedule (Alpha/Beta/GA) with control owners and acceptance criteria
Consequence matrix PDF: mapping missed milestones -> mitigation & rollback steps
Automated pre-audit checklist in Console (read-only view) and exportable evidence package
Owner runbook for on-call escalation during audit cutovers
Tracking dashboard with per-control progress and burn-down metrics
milestones: Wave 0: Control inventory & gap analysis complete - 2026-02-28
Wave 1: SSO/SAML config automation + test tenants - 2026-03-31
Wave 2: Audit-log retention policy implementation + tenant opt-in - 2026-04-15
Final: Pre-audit dry run and sign-off - 2026-05-01
acceptance_criteria: Each control has an assigned owner and documented acceptance test
Console shows per-customer evidence readiness >= 90% for sample tenants
Automated export produces a signed evidence bundle matching SOC2 template
Rollout plan includes a fallback path and a documented consequence for missed gating
risks: Evidence automation misses edge cases for private deployments (air-gapped setups)
SSO provider variability leads to longer integration cycles for some customers
Scope creep: trying to cover all audit artifacts in initial waves
mitigations: Define minimum viable evidence for each control and defer non-blocking artifacts
Add a two-week buffer to each wave and hold weekly dependency check-ins
Provide a documented manual fallback for air-gapped customers and track as sub-issue
Reserve a neutral rollback policy and test it during the pre-audit dry run
